changelog: - **Erasure reaches the person on a company record, inside their own tenant only** (#2434, under #2396). `src/lib/accountErasure.ts` never mentioned `CompanyInquiry`, so an anonymised or deleted account read "Erased candidate" while the same person's name, e-mail address and phone number sat untouched on the enquiry they arrived through and on the `Company.contactName/contactEmail/contactPhone` of the account they are the contact of (#2407). Both erasure paths (`hardDeleteUser`, `anonymizeUser`, and therefore the admin erase endpoint, the self-service `DELETE /api/account` and the orphan-applicant retention sweep) now scrub those rows, matched on the address read before the user row is rewritten or deleted, in the same `$transaction` as the rest of the scrub. The module's split is applied: `CompanyInquiry.message` (what they wrote) is tombstoned, `contactName`/`email`/`phone`/`note` (what identifies them or was written about them) are scrubbed, with the required columns taking the `User` row's tombstone (`Erased contact`, `erased-<id>@erased.local`, now one `erasedAddress()` for both). The `Company` row, its name, needs, offers, requisitions and relations, and the enquiry's company name, roles, status, conversion link and dates all stay. **Tenant scope:** an address is not a tenant boundary and `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` is off (#2542), so an unfiltered `updateMany` (the unmerged draft 135a367a) would rewrite another tenant's lead with the same address. Both writes are narrowed to the erased person's org (read from their own row, falling back to `defaultOrgId()`), via `orgScoped()`; for the default org, rows not yet stamped by the deploy backfill (`orgId` NULL, e.g. a company created since the last deploy) are included, because that backfill assigns them to the default org, and they are never touched for any other org. No new screen, no second erasure path: the name confirmation, the password step-up and the `user.erase.*` `ActivityLog` row are unchanged. The rule lives dependency-free in `src/lib/companyContactErasure.ts` (unit-tested in `scripts/test/company-contact-erasure.test.mjs`, 100% lines, floored at 95; 6/11 fail against an unscoped filter); pinned end to end by `e2e/erasure-company-contact.spec.ts` (two tenants holding the same address, an unstamped row and a same-tenant bystander, through the real endpoint). Known gaps stay listed in the module: the admins' `signup.companyInquiry` notification carries the contact's name with no address (#2106), and a contact who never had an account is #2559.

en: Erasing a person's account now also removes them from the company records they appear on: their name, e-mail address and phone number are cleared from the company enquiry they sent and from the company's contact details. The company itself and its history are kept, and records belonging to other organisations are never changed.
tr: Bir kişinin hesabını silmek artık onu yer aldığı firma kayıtlarından da çıkarıyor: adı, e-posta adresi ve telefon numarası gönderdiği firma başvurusundan ve firmanın iletişim bilgilerinden temizleniyor. Firmanın kendisi ve geçmişi korunuyor; başka kuruluşlara ait kayıtlar hiçbir zaman değiştirilmiyor.
de: Wird das Konto einer Person gelöscht, wird sie jetzt auch aus den Unternehmensdatensätzen entfernt, in denen sie vorkommt: Name, E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer werden aus der von ihr gesendeten Unternehmensanfrage und aus den Kontaktdaten des Unternehmens gelöscht. Das Unternehmen selbst und seine Historie bleiben erhalten, und Datensätze anderer Organisationen werden nie verändert.
